column1: # RBB SRv6 qualification — circuit_info TEMPLATE (replace with your values).
# This file is the SINGLE source of physical wiring for the RBB SRv6 slice.
# taac/testconfigs/routing/util/bgp_rbb_topology.py derives from it:
#   * CORE port-channels + members — rows whose two endpoints are BOTH DUTs and
#     whose local endpoint carries a parent port-channel (columns 4 & 8). Members
#     are grouped per node under that parent.
#   * IXIA edges + IXIA-port map     — rows with role=IXIA (last column). The
#     DUT-side local_interface maps to the IXIA-side neighbor_interface
#     expressed as "slot/port" (e.g. 1/3) so it drops straight into IxNetwork.
# `./scripts/run-rbb-srv6.sh --init` copies this into the default local
# configuration directory. Bind the RBB roles in rbb.env with
# TAAC_RBB_R1_HOST / TAAC_RBB_R2_HOST; they must match the hostnames below. Use
# runner --config-dir when the initialized configuration is outside the checkout.
# Columns:
#   hostname
#   neighbor_hostname
#   status
# status=3 => active. Lines starting with '#' are comments. All names below are
# generic placeholders — replace with your real interfaces / IXIA card-port pairs.
# --- Core underlay: two one-member port-channels between R1 and R2. This shape
# works with fresh-image bootstrap. Case 2 may add rows with the same parent
# names to describe wider preconfigured LAGs. Each row describes both ends. ---
rbb-r1.lab.example
rbb-r1.lab.example
